findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the Vitest day-grouping tests to tell local days from UTC days on any runner. Actual: they build times with local-time constructors in the process zone, so on a UTC CI runner a UTC-date implementation would pass them. Only the e2e spec (New York zone) guards this in CI. The behaviour itself is correct in every zone tried.
findings.fix: Optional: pin a non-UTC zone for the grouping unit/acceptance tests, or add one case with a fixed UTC instant whose local date differs.

summary: All 15 SPEC items pass. npm test passes with 1381 tests and 0 failures, and lint and typecheck are clean. The statistics e2e suite passes 18/18 in Chromium and WebKit.
